notes.title: WWE 2K17 rumbling onto PC February 7th
notes.content: In what has become an annual wrasslin’ tradition, WWE 2K17 [official site] is coming to PC on February 7th, months after its console launch. The console version is the best WWE release in the last few years, with marginal improvements in the career mode and creation suites, and better in-ring action. Most notable is the fact that triple threat matches and the like are actually enjoyable now, thanks to longer rest spots outside the ring for battered wrestlers, allowing for better match flow. I still wouldn’t go so far as to recommend it, but it’s on the right track. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: WWE 2K16 has been updated [patch 1.01]
notes.content:
[b][u]Today's update includes the following:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Reduced loading time for all supported machine specs.  This fix does increase memory the footprint for the loading screens and may impact Min Spec users if they play with a lot background process running concurrently with the title, in which case load times will revert to their original, pre-patch times.
[*] Fixed crash in Community Creations associated with backing out while items are loading and then re-entering the download menu.
[*] Fixed crash during custom entrances that contain simultaneous video effect and pyrotechnics
[/list]
